_comment: The home front's crises (src/engine/crisis_engine.py). Checked every week from first_turn.
EPIDEMICS: with outbreak_chance a disease breaks out in a Kestrian settlement or a front-line formation.
Per infected SETTLEMENT per week: civil morale -city_morale; factory output -factory_output (x2 for an
industrial centre; total capped at max_output_penalty). Per infected FORMATION per week: unit_attrition of
its men die in their beds, and unit_morale. Unless quarantined or cordoned, each infected site spreads the
disease with spread_chance to the nearest clean settlement within spread_range_city rows (from a city) or
formation / settlement within spread_range_unit rows (from a formation). Infections burn out on their own
with burnout_chance per week. A new outbreak (and a spreading one, at most every nag_weeks) raises a
CRITICAL EMERGENCY: fund QUARANTINE PROTOCOLS (quarantine_base + quarantine_per_site CR; every site stops
spreading and is cleared in quarantine_weeks), throw a military cordon around it (no cost in money, civil
and military morale suffer; spreading stops, no cure), or leave the doctors to cope. Researching Field
Medicine clears every infection within medicine_weeks and halves the outbreak chance.
DISASTERS: with disaster_chance a disaster strikes a Kestrian region of a matching terrain: it wrecks rail and
road (cells) within radius rows of a railway in the region, kills civilians and hurts morale, and raises
a CRITICAL EMERGENCY: fund relief (relief_cost), deploy the nearest formation not in battle (it cannot
move or fight for military_weeks weeks), or ignore it (ignore_morale). Combat Engineers repair the damage.

trench_typhus.name: Trench Typhus
trench_typhus.description: Louse-borne fever of the trenches. Whole companies go down with it.

industrial_flu.name: Industrial Influenza
industrial_flu.description: A virulent influenza sweeping the crowded factory barracks.

cholera.name: Cholera
cholera.description: Bad water in overcrowded districts: the old killer of besieged and starving towns.

severe_flooding.name: Severe Flooding
severe_flooding.text: Days of torrential rain have burst the embankments. {region} is under water: bridges swept away, the railway embankment breached in a dozen places, villages drowned.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.text: A violent earthquake has struck {region}. Tunnels have collapsed, cuttings are choked with rock, towns lie in ruins and thousands are trapped.

mine_collapse.name: Mine Collapse
mine_collapse.text: The main shaft of the {region} colliery has collapsed after an explosion. Hundreds of miners are entombed; subsidence has torn up the colliery railway, and the steel mills are starved of coal.
